name: PyPI
summary: Python Package Index metadata: a project's latest info, every release and file with hashes, known vulnerabilities, the simple index, and PyPI-wide size stats.
notes: Keyless. JSON and Index responses are CDN-cached and not rate limited at the edge, but PyPI asks for a unique User-Agent with contact details, serial requests over time rather than thousands in minutes, and may block abusive clients.
Responses carry an ETag; respect it on repeated requests. For watching new releases PyPI recommends its RSS feeds.
In the JSON API, downloads is always -1, has_sig always false and bugtrack_url always null; the project-level releases key is deprecated in favour of the Index API.

endpoints.name: Get a project
endpoints.summary: Latest-version metadata (summary, license, requires_dist, project URLs), every release's files with hashes, and vulnerabilities of the latest release.

endpoints.name: Get one release of a project
endpoints.summary: Metadata, files and known vulnerabilities of one version.

endpoints.name: List a project's distribution files
endpoints.summary: Every wheel and sdist URL of a project with hashes, from the PEP 503/691 index.

project.description: Project name; matched case-insensitively with _, - and . treated as equal.

accept.description: application/vnd.pypi.simple.v1+json for JSON; without it the HTML index comes back.

notes: The X-PyPI-Last-Serial header gives the project's latest serial.

endpoints.name: List every project
endpoints.summary: The names (and last serials) of all projects on PyPI.

accept.description: application/vnd.pypi.simple.v1+json for JSON; without it the HTML index comes back.

notes: A very large response: hundreds of thousands of projects in one document.

endpoints.name: Get PyPI storage stats
endpoints.summary: Total size of all packages in bytes and the top 100 packages by size.

accept.description: Must be application/json, or an HTML page comes back.
